guidance_documents.title: Formal Meetings Between the FDA and Sponsors or Applicants of PDUFA Products

requirements.source_quote: Sponsors should include a randomized, double-blind, placebo-controlled trial design for Phase 2 obesity studies.
requirements.requirement_text: Phase 2 obesity trials must use randomized double-blind placebo-controlled design.

requirements.source_quote: The primary endpoint for obesity trials should be percent change from baseline in body weight.
requirements.requirement_text: Primary endpoint must be percent change from baseline in body weight.

requirements.source_quote: A weight loss threshold responder analysis (proportion achieving >=5% weight loss) should be included as a key secondary endpoint.
requirements.requirement_text: Key secondary endpoint: proportion of patients achieving >=5% body weight loss.

requirements.source_quote: Cardiovascular safety must be addressed, including monitoring for heart rate, blood pressure, and MACE events.
requirements.requirement_text: EOP2 package must address cardiovascular safety monitoring plan.

requirements.source_quote: The EOP2 briefing document should include a detailed description of the proposed Phase 3 design including sample size justification.
requirements.requirement_text: EOP2 briefing document must include proposed Phase 3 design with sample size justification.

agency_concerns.source_document: FDA Type C Meeting Minutes, GLP-1 obesity program, 2022
agency_concerns.concern_text: FDA has previously raised concerns about cardiovascular safety monitoring adequacy for GLP-1 agonists in obesity, specifically the absence of an independent MACE adjudication committee.
agency_concerns.resolution_guidance: Establish an independent MACE adjudication committee and pre-specify CV stopping rules; reference the 2022 agency correspondence explicitly.

agency_concerns.source_document: Endocrinologic and Metabolic Drugs Advisory Committee, 2021
agency_concerns.concern_text: Advisory committee questioned the durability of weight loss beyond the treatment period and the adequacy of follow-up duration.
agency_concerns.resolution_guidance: Include an off-treatment follow-up period in Phase 3 to characterise weight regain.

prior_positions.position_text: The primary endpoint for the Phase 2 ACCESS II study is percent change from baseline in body weight at Week 36.
prior_positions.notes: FDA accepted the primary endpoint definition without comment.
